hypothesis: Implement a keyed protocol parser (keyed-v2) that requires each verdict to explicitly identify its article via article_id. This eliminates the positional association defect by: 1) Validating that every article has exactly one verdict, 2) Detecting duplicate or unknown article_ids, 3) Rejecting when the association is ambiguous or incomplete. The parser uses PROTOCOL_KEYED ('keyed-v2') and refuses with appropriate kinds (count_mismatch, duplicate_id, unknown_id, missing_id) when association cannot be guaranteed.
